## Skills inventory

For each skill area, describe what your group actually used it for. If you did not use a skill, say so and note why.

### Functions & refactoring (W2)

*What we did:* To make interactive plots, a create_hover function was created. The function serves multiple times and makes troubleshooting easier.

*What worked well:* The function worked well for the first simple two plots.

*What was hard:* It was hard to apply the function to the other plots, since they are more complicated. So paste was used instead.

### Debugging (W3)

*What we did:*  We tried to read the error messages carefully. We also used version control as a debugging tool (log -> diff -> bisect)

*What worked well:* Using browser() inside the function, it makes your execution pause there and takes you to an interactive mode where you can inspect variables.

*What was hard:* Error messages would help you spot the problem but sometimes you don't know how to solve it by yourself.
